item.title: Pokopia Zero Dawn
item.description: There’s a chair at the top of a spire of scrap metal in Pokopia. The chair faces the sea. It was here that the last human in the world sat in wait for the towering tidal wave that would finish wiping all life from the face of the planet. Spoilers inside.

item.title: An Evening in Pokopia
item.description: If you can’t beat ’em, join ’em. Pokemon’s spin on Palworld’s base building game removes battling, trainers, and (arguably) gyms, but it all works somehow.
